id: title:Gilbert09:explain why incremental sync is unavailable on a table

review.posthog_relevance: Provides clearer user-facing guidance and error diagnostics for incremental and append-only warehouse replication workflows when required column types are missing.
review.reason: The observed changes replace short, generic error messages with more descriptive ones, improving user comprehension of why warehouse replication failed. This is a localized, bounded improvement to the user experience and supportability of warehouse ingestion, not a systemic architectural change or unverified benefit.
review.uncertainty: The actual backend implementation and warehouse connector behavior are not visible; the benefit is inferred solely from the change to the error message string. No test or recovery behavior is demonstrated.

observations.limitations: Only frontend UI strings were supplied. No backend implementation, schema parsing, or warehouse connector behavior is visible. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Replaced a short disabled reason with a longer, more descriptive one.
observations.code_quote: 'Incremental replication needs a timestamp, date, or auto-incrementing numeric column to track new rows, and none was found on this table',
observations.posthog_connection: Provides clearer user-facing guidance when incremental replication cannot proceed due to missing column types.
